reason: A DeepSeek Harness provider plugin that integrates ChatGPT Codex login, model selection, usage display, and optional search and image capabilities.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 ChatGPT Codex 登录、模型目录与对话能力，并可选启用搜索、图像查看和图像生成。
summaries.en: Adds ChatGPT Codex login, model selection, and chat access to DeepSeek Harness, with optional search, image viewing, and image generation.

capabilities: ChatGPT OAuth sign-in and session management
ChatGPT Codex model access through an external backend API
Optional local and public-network image viewing
Optional image generation that writes generated files
Configurable model catalog and retry behavior
